{{Money|5,000}} on death (Hard) |event_spawned_by = [[Frost Spirit]] |event_hidden = No |event_fly = {{Attr|Fly|Yes}} |event_ghost = No |event_lead = No |event_immunity = {{Attr|Bloated}} (Variable) |event_ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Ice Projectile}}''' - Fires an ice projectile at a tower or unit in its range of 20, freezing them for 2 seconds and dealing 250 damage to units in an explosion range of 5. |event_ability1_cooldown = 10 }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Frost Mage''' is a [[Flying]] enemy that appears in the [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. Like most of that mode's enemies, it first appeared in the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. It is effectively a stronger version of the [[Crying Angel]], as it has higher health and an ability, though it does move slower. With its ability, it will shoot an ice projectile at towers and units. This will stun towers hit for 3 seconds and deal 150 damage to units, high enough to kill majority of units. ==Logbook Description== "''Frost Mages are envied by the Crying Angels for reaching sainthood in their beliefs where the Frost Spirit grants them a portion of its power. Though chained by their duties, they remain devoted followers, their clothing reflecting both their strict order and granted freedoms. They fire ice projectiles at towers and units, dealing Area of Effect damage.''"; ==Appearance== The '''Frost Mage''' is an angel with light grey skin and four grey wings on its back, chained to it with grey chains. On its head, it wears a grey visor, covering its eyes, and it has long, white hair. It wears a white shirt and grey pants, with its arms also being covered in ice. On its arms, it has multiple arm-bands with cut off chains. It also has a blue ice halo floating above its head. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers with flying detection, like the [[Pursuit]], [[Crook Boss]], [[Golden Crook Boss]], [[Kingpin]] and [[Ranger]], are recommended. **As the [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]] have quite high range, they can easily stay away from the '''Frost Mage''', making them less likely to be frozen. *The [[Field Medic]] can be used to grant your units immunity to being damaged by it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseFrostMage.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} FrostMageIconIG.png|'''Frost Mage''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Frost Mage''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''16 December 2024''' -
